author: claude
summary: Root-caused and fixed the VoiceLabPage crash flagged earlier this session: navigating to /voices/:id crashed for every voice on a cold/full page load (never on in-app client-side routing). Root cause: SamplesSection called useVariantActions(profiles[0], ...) unconditionally -- on a cold load, profiles is genuinely empty for one render (the speaker_profiles fetch hasn't resolved yet), so profiles[0] is undefined, and the hook read profile.preview_url/asset_base_url/name/speed with no null guard, throwing before the component's own '!profile' early-return check ever ran.

files.change: Added a stable module-level EMPTY_PROFILE placeholder; useVariantActions is now called with `profile ?? EMPTY_PROFILE` instead of a possibly-undefined `profile`, since hooks can't be called conditionally. The real `profile` variable still drives the existing '!profile -> No profile found' empty-state branch, unchanged.

tests_added: frontend/tests/unit/pages/VoiceLab/SamplesSectionColdLoad.test.tsx -- new file, deliberately does NOT mock useVariantActions (only the playerBus store, a true external boundary) so it exercises the real hook body with an empty profiles array. The existing SamplesSection.test.tsx mocks useVariantActions entirely, which is exactly why this bug went undetected -- the mock hid the real crash.
revert_checked: git stash of SamplesSection.tsx: the new test fails with the exact production error (TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'preview_url')); restored and green.
verified_live: Confirmed the actual crash first by reproducing it in the browser (cold navigate to /voices/:id for multiple real voices, e.g. 'Dark Fantasy' and 'Woman', both crashed) and by confirming it did NOT reproduce via in-app SPA navigation (history.pushState + popstate) to the same route -- this was the key clue pointing at initial-data-fetch timing rather than a data-shape bug. After the fix, both a hard reload and SPA navigation to /voices/:id render correctly for both previously-crashing voices, with no console error.
